item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The active southwest monsoon will continue to bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve gradually and it will be very hot over southern China in the following few days. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region.

Date/Month: 16/06 (Sunday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times in the morning.
Temp range: 25 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
